about_the_game:
With a ferocious creature destroying entire dimensions without even trying, only the Dimensional Travelers are able to stand in it's way. Doller, a lazy apprentice Mage, is about to be sent on the adventure of a lifetime. Teaming up with the other Dimensional Travelers, Yeign; a Navish Warrior, Freia; a well mannered Demon Spawn, and Yosei; a Pixie Thief that will come at you if you call him a Fairy; and following the Commander's orders, can this misfit group really stop the destruction of the very fabric of the entire Universe? Can they figure out the Mystics' plans before it's too late? Can they stop the hunger and greed?

Being a solo dev project by a professional sci-fi/fantasy writer, Dimensional Gates is the next amazing adventure you're set to experience. With hours and hours of gameplay, storylines, and battling enemies, you can feel the heart and soul that was placed into the making of this game well. 

David Listzwan - "I wanted to create something truly new, not just expand on existing AAA concepts. Dimensional Gates is a book you play, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in an RPG with fresh ideas like an in-game PC, unlockable vending machines, and impactful player choices. This game is my guarantee of a quality, immersive, and unforgettable adventure."

Being disabled and living in isolation for the last 7 and a half years, David made Dimensional Gates not just to make a game, but to make something beyond special for the player to experience. 

  • 5 World Maps 230 x 178 blocks large and over 600 detailed maps in total

  • Night and day cycles with the ability to break into buildings to rob them

  • Different battles for the Dimensional Beast and good and bad endings in credits for each main character

  • Powerful original storylines and character arcs causing dimensions to feel different

  • Working PC in the Airship Cabin that has literature, shows, news reels, and fully working video games 

  • Original Table Top games you can play with NPCs and win prizes

  • NPCs working and doing complicated tasks making each world feel alive

  • New Game Plus allows player to earn points to unlock advantages

  • Amazing Original Sound Track by composer Anthony Fusilier

Extras:

  • Laurel's Day - RPG on the PC where you follow Laurel through her school day

  • Laurel's Locket - Beating Laurel's Day unlocks Laurel's Locket in Dimensional Gates

  • Imminent Distress - Survival on the PC where you're stranded on a dangerous planet

  • Crystal Pick - Beating Imminent Distress unlocks Crystal Pick in Dimensional Gates

  • Knixer's Revenge - Original table top game you can play with NPCs

  • Camping Gear - Beating Knixer's Revenge unlocks the Camping Gear in Dimensional Gates

  • 16 Usable Icons of characters from the game

* Game designed using RPG Maker MV Engine (screen freeze issues fixed, flawless transfer to airship cabin, preloaded music for instant play, and minimal plugins for smooth gameplay and minimal loading)

detailed_description:
Collector's Edition

The Collector's Edition, due to Steam's policies, will now only include the amazing Original Sound Track by Anthony Fusilier, and Laurel's Day. Unfortunately Steam will not allow Apps to be added to the Collectors Edition or anything that can be downloaded and accessed separate from having to load the main game and see it in there. Because of that, the other goodies will be only sold on other platforms once Not Allowed to Die expands to them. 


Important Game Controls

For those not familiar with RPG Maker titles, there are a few things to know:

F4 - Full Screen Mode

F5 - Restart Game

The Steam Overlay can leave images in the black border of the game's engine, using F4 to leave full screen and return will clean that up. Sorry for the inconvenience, but it's a glitch in the overlay.
